name: Lost Sheep
overview: The biblical theme of the lost sheep vividly illustrates humanity's tendency to stray from God's ways, as expressed in Psalms 119:176 and Isaiah 53:6. Jesus identifies His mission as seeking the lost sheep of Israel (Matthew 15:24), emphasizing God's relentless pursuit of those who have gone astray. The Parable of the Lost Sheep (Matthew 18:12-13) highlights the joy in heaven over one sinner who repents, underscoring the immense value God places on each individual. This theme reminds believers of God's mercy and the call to seek and restore the wandering.
